title: Sphinx Artist of the Underworld
description: A hairless sphinx cat wearing glasses and a patterned vest sits at a dark wooden desk, writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil. Behind it, a large skull and a swirling colorful river of dancing skeletons in paper boats flow toward a sunset, with potion bottles, hanging lanterns, and a radiant sun in the background.
prompt: A hairless sphinx cat with yellow eyes and glasses, wearing a patterned vest and a tiny crown of skeletons, sits at a black wooden desk writing in a notebook with a pencil. Behind the cat is a giant skull, colorful swirling psychedelic river filled with dancing skeletons in paper boats, potion shelves with glowing bottles, hanging lanterns, and a bright sun in a twilight sky over a surreal landscape.
